## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] feat
- [ ] fix
- [ ] docs
- [ ] chore
- [ ] refactor
- [ ] test
- [ ] ci

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run validate:secrets`
- [ ] GitHub Actions CI checks passed

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `type/short-description` (e.g., `feat/add-release-workflow`)
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits format
- [ ] Updated docs when workflows or governance changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or sensitive data introduced
